  <style>
    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       DESIGN TOKENS — mirrored from Figma
       Single source of truth for all modules.
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    :root {
      /* ── Backgrounds ── */
      --color-backgrounds-brand-blue: #EDF9FE;
      --color-backgrounds-primary:   #FFFFFF;
      --color-backgrounds-secondary: #F8F8FB;
      --color-white:                 #FFFFFF;

      /* ── Text ── */
      --color-text-primary:   #1A1A2E;
      --color-text-secondary: #56575A;  /* Figma: color-texts-secondary */

      /* ── Gradients (Figma: Gradients/Holafly) ── */
      --colors-gradients-holafly-magenta:      #E12B57;
      --colors-gradients-holafly-dark-magenta: #C8094E;
      --Gradients-Holafly: linear-gradient(
        105deg,
        var(--colors-gradients-holafly-magenta)      0%,
        var(--colors-gradients-holafly-dark-magenta) 97.24%
      );

      /* ── Radius (Figma) ── */
      --radius-2xl: 24px;  /* Figma: radius/2xl */
      --radius-l:   16px;  /* Figma: radius/l   */

      /* ── Typography (Figma: ModernEra/Display/Desktop) ── */
      --font-family-title:        "Modern Era", "DM Sans", sans-serif;
      --font-family-body:         "DM Sans", sans-serif;
      --font-size-Display:        60px;
      --font-line-height-Display: 70px;

      /* ── Spacing ── */
      --space-xs:   4px;
      --space-sm:   8px;
      --space-md:  16px;
      --space-lg:  24px;
      --space-xl:  40px;
      --space-2xl: 64px;
      --space-3xl: 96px;

      /* ── Transitions ── */
      --transition-base: 0.25s ease;
    }



    /* ── Skip link (accessibility) ── */
    .skip-link {
      position: absolute;
      top: -40px;
      left: 0;
      background: var(--color-text-primary);
      color: var(--color-white);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      z-index: 9999;
      font-family: var(--font-family-body);
      font-size: 14px;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 0 0 4px 0;
      transition: top 0.2s;
    }
    .skip-link:focus { top: 0; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; overflow-x: hidden; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-family-body);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      background-color: var(--color-white);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       MODULE: HERO SECTION
       ─────────────────────────────────────────
       Figma specs applied:
         Container  → border-radius: 0 0 56px 56px
                      background: var(--color-backgrounds-brand-blue)
         h1         → font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era")
                      font-size: var(--font-size-Display, 60px)
                      font-weight: 500
                      line-height: var(--font-line-height-Display, 70px)
         CTA        → border-radius: var(--radius-m, 12px)
                      background: var(--Gradients-Holafly)
                      href: https://partners.holafly.com/register-impact/
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .hero {
      /* Figma: container */
      border-radius: 0 0 56px 56px;
      background: var(--color-backgrounds-brand-blue, #EDF9FE);

      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
      padding-bottom: 80px;
    }

    /* Decorative SVG background layer */
    .hero__background {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero__background svg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }

    /* Layout container */
    .hero__container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: var(--space-lg);
    }

    /* Centered content column */
    .hero__content {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      gap: var(--space-lg);
      max-width: 740px;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }


    /* ── Hero eyebrow label ── */
    .hero__eyebrow {
      color: var(--color-texts-secondary, #56575A);
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 14px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 20px;
    }

    /* ── h1 — Figma: [Primary] ModernEra/Display/Desktop ── */
    .hero__heading {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: var(--font-size-Display, 60px);
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: var(--font-line-height-Display, 70px);

      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.7s ease 0.1s forwards;
    }

    /* "eSIM provider" — accent color from brand */
    .hero__heading--accent {
      color: var(--colors-gradients-holafly-magenta);
    }

    /* ── Subtitle paragraph ── */
    .hero__body {
      font-family: var(--font-family-body);
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;

      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(14px);
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.7s ease 0.25s forwards;
    }

    /* ── CTA wrapper ── */
    .hero__actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-md);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: var(--space-sm);

      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(14px);
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.7s ease 0.4s forwards;
    }

    /* ── CTA button — Figma: radius/m + Gradients/Holafly ── */
    .btn-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-sm);

      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-white);
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;

      /* Figma */
      border-radius: var(--radius-m, 12px);
      background: var(--Gradients-Holafly,
        linear-gradient(105deg, #E12B57 0%, #C8094E 97.24%)
      );

      border: none;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      cursor: pointer;

      transition:
        filter    var(--transition-base),
        transform var(--transition-base);
    }

    .btn-cta:hover,
    .btn-cta:focus-visible {
      filter: brightness(1.1);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .btn-cta:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
      filter: brightness(0.97);
    }

    .btn-cta:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(225, 43, 87, 0.45);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       KEYFRAMES
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    @keyframes fadeSlideUp {
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       RESPONSIVE — TABLET  ≤ 900px
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      :root {
        --font-size-Display:        44px;
        --font-line-height-Display: 52px;
      }

      .hero {
        padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
        padding-bottom: 60px;
      }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       RESPONSIVE — MOBILE  ≤ 480px
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      :root {
        --font-size-Display:        32px;
        --font-line-height-Display: 40px;
      }

      .hero {
        border-radius: 0 0 32px 32px;
        padding-top: var(--space-xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-xl);
      }

      .hero__actions {
        width: auto;
        flex-direction: row;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
      }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       ACCESSIBILITY — Reduced motion
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .hero__heading,
      .hero__body,
      .hero__actions {
        animation: none;
        opacity: 1;

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════

       ─────────────────────────────────────────
       Structure:
         <section.trusted>

             .trusted__carousel   (overflow hidden)
               .trusted__track    (animated strip x2)
             .trusted__stats      (3-col icon row)

    .trusted {
      background-color: var(--color-white);
      padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-xl);
    }

    .trusted__container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: var(--space-lg);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-xl);
    }

    /* Carousel — full section width, sits outside the max-width container */
    .trusted__carousel-wrap {
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* ── H2 — Figma: ModernEra/Headlines/H2/Desktop ── */
    .trusted__heading {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 34px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 42px;
    }

    /* ── Carousel wrapper — full viewport width ── */
    .trusted__carousel {
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
        to right,
        transparent 0%,
        black 5%,
        black 95%,
        transparent 100%
      );
      mask-image: linear-gradient(
        to right,
        transparent 0%,
        black 5%,
        black 95%,
        transparent 100%
      );
    }

    /* ── Scrolling track: original + clone side by side ── */
    .trusted__track {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
      width: max-content;
      /* Scroll exactly half (one full set of logos) */
      animation: scrollBrands 50s linear infinite;
    }

    .trusted__track:hover {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    /* Each logo card */
    .trusted__logo {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 184px;
      height: 100px;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      opacity: 0.5;
      filter: grayscale(100%);
      mix-blend-mode: luminosity;
    }

    /* ── Stats row ── */
    .trusted__stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--space-lg);
      width: 100%;
    }

    .trusted__stat {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-sm);
    }

    .trusted__stat-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* Figma: ModernEra/Headlines/H4/Desktop */
    .trusted__stat-text {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 22px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 28px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Vertical pipe divider between stats */
    .trusted__divider {
      width: 1px;
      height: 28px;
      background-color: #D1D5DB;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ── Carousel keyframe ── */
    @keyframes scrollBrands {
      0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* ── Responsive: tablet ── */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .trusted__stat-text {
        font-size: 17px;
        line-height: 24px;
      }

      .trusted__divider {
        display: none;
      }

      .trusted__stats {

        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        padding-inline: var(--space-md);

        font-size: 26px;

      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .trusted__track {
        animation: none;
      }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       MODULE: HOW DO I BECOME A PARTNER
       ─────────────────────────────────────────
       Layout: 3-col grid
         Col 1 → step 01 (row 1) + step 02 (row 2)
         Col 2 → step 03 (row 1) + step 04 (row 2)
         Col 3 → step 05 (row-span 2, with illustration)

       Structure:
         <section.howto>
           .howto__container
             .howto__header
               h2.howto__heading
               p.howto__subheading
             .howto__grid
               article.howto__card[data-step] (×4 small)
               article.howto__card--featured   (step 05)
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .howto {
      background-color: var(--color-white);
      padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
    }

    .howto__container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: var(--space-lg);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-xl);
    }

    /* ── Header ── */
    .howto__header {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-md);
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
    }

    /* Figma: ModernEra/Headlines/H2/Desktop */
    .howto__heading {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 34px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 42px;
    }

    /* Subtitle — reuses Body/Large/Regular token */
    .howto__subheading {
      color: var(--color-texts-secondary, #56575A);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 22px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* ── 3-column grid ── */
    .howto__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      grid-template-rows: repeat(2, auto);
      gap: var(--space-md);
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* ── Base card (steps 01–04) ── */
    .howto__card {
      /* Figma: radius/2xl + backgrounds-secondary */
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 24px);
      background: var(--color-backgrounds-secondary, #F8F8FB);
      padding: var(--space-lg);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-lg);

      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .howto__card.is-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* Stagger per card */
    .howto__card:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
    .howto__card:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
    .howto__card:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.19s; }
    .howto__card:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.26s; }
    .howto__card:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.33s; }

    /* ── Featured card (step 05) — right col, spans 2 rows ── */
    .howto__card--featured {
      grid-column: 3;
      grid-row: 1 / span 2;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      min-height: 320px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /*
      Desktop explicit placement — keeps HTML in logical order 01→05.
      ┌────────┬────────┬──────────┐
      │  01    │  03    │          │
      ├────────┼────────┤   05     │
      │  02    │  04    │          │
      └────────┴────────┴──────────┘
    */
    .howto__card[data-step="1"] { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
    .howto__card[data-step="2"] { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
    .howto__card[data-step="3"] { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
    .howto__card[data-step="4"] { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; }
    .howto__card[data-step="5"] { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / span 2; }

    /* Illustration inside featured card */
    .howto__card-image {
      width: 100%;
      flex: 1;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center bottom;
      margin-top: var(--space-md);
      max-height: 220px;
    }

    /* ── Step number badge — Figma: radius/l + backgrounds-primary ── */
    .howto__step {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: fit-content;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-l, 16px);
      background: var(--color-backgrounds-primary, #FFF);

      /* Figma: ModernEra/Body/Extra large/Bold */
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: var(--font-size-7, 18px);
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 26px;
    }

    /* ── Card body ── */
    .howto__card-body {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-sm);
    }

    /* Reuse H4/Desktop token */
    .howto__card-title {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 18px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 24px;
    }

    /* Reuse Body/Large/Regular token */
    .howto__card-text {
      color: var(--color-texts-secondary, #56575A);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 22px;
    }

    /* ── Responsive: tablet ── */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .howto__grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        grid-template-rows: auto;
      }

      /* Reset explicit placement — cards flow in DOM order 01→02→03→04→05 */
      .howto__card[data-step="1"],
      .howto__card[data-step="2"],
      .howto__card[data-step="3"],
      .howto__card[data-step="4"],
      .howto__card[data-step="5"] {
        grid-column: auto;
        grid-row: auto;
      }

      .howto__card--featured {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--space-lg);
      }

      .howto__card-image {
        max-height: 160px;
        max-width: 200px;
        margin-top: 0;
      }

      .howto__heading {
        font-size: 28px;
        line-height: 36px;
      }
    }

    /* ── Responsive: mobile ── */
    @media (max-width: 540px) {
      .howto__grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .howto__card--featured {
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .howto__card-image {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 180px;
      }

      .howto__heading {
        font-size: 24px;
        line-height: 32px;
      }
    }

    /* ── Reduced motion ── */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .howto__card {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
        transition: none;
      }
    }

       MODULE: FAQ ACCORDION
       ─────────────────────────────────────────
       Structure:
         <section.faq>
           .faq__container
             .faq__header
               span.faq__eyebrow  ("FAQs" badge)
               h2.faq__heading
             .faq__list
               details.faq__item (×N)
                 summary.faq__question
                   span.faq__question-text

                 div.faq__answer
                   p.faq__answer-text
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .faq {
      background-color: var(--color-white);
      padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
    }

    .faq__container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: var(--space-lg);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-xl);
    }

    /* ── Header ── */
    .faq__header {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-sm);
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* "FAQs" eyebrow badge */
    .faq__eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background-color: #3B82F6;
      color: var(--color-white);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
    }

    /* Figma: ModernEra/Headlines/H3/Desktop */
    .faq__subheading {
      color: var(--color-texts-secondary, #56575A);
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 28px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 34px;
    }

    /* Figma: ModernEra/Headlines/H2/Desktop */
    .faq__heading {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      text-align: center;
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 34px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 42px;
    }

    /* ── Accordion list ── */
    .faq__list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* ── Each accordion item ── */
    .faq__item {
      border: 1px solid var(--color-borders-subtle, #E4E6EA);
      border-radius: var(--radius-m, 12px);
      background: var(--color-white);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }

    .faq__item[open] {
      border-bottom: none;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    }

    /* Remove default marker */
    .faq__item summary { list-style: none; }
    .faq__item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }

    /* ── Question row (summary) ── */
    .faq__question {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-md);
      padding: 18px var(--space-lg);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
    }

    .faq__question:hover {
      background-color: #FAFAFA;
    }

    /* Figma: Body/Large/Regular */
    .faq__question-text {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 16px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 22px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    /* Chevron icon */
    .faq__icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .faq__icon svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      fill: none;
      overflow: visible;
      display: block;
    }

    .faq__item[open] .faq__icon {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    /* ── Answer panel — Figma tokens ── */
    .faq__answer {
      border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--color-borders-subtle, #E4E6EA);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-borders-subtle, #E4E6EA);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--color-borders-subtle, #E4E6EA);
      background: var(--color-backgrounds-secondary, #F8F8FB);

      /* Figma: container layout */
      display: flex;
      padding: 20px;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      align-self: stretch;

      /* Smooth open/close via grid rows */
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: 0fr;
      transition: grid-template-rows 0.35s ease, padding 0.35s ease;
      padding-top: 0;
      padding-bottom: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .faq__item[open] .faq__answer {
      grid-template-rows: 1fr;
      padding-top: 20px;
      padding-bottom: 20px;
    }

    /* Inner wrapper needed for grid row trick */
    .faq__answer-inner {
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 0;
    }

    /* Figma: Body/Medium/Regular */

      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-family-title, "Modern Era");
      font-size: 14px;
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 20px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    /* ── Responsive ── */
    @media (max-width: 540px) {
      .faq__heading { font-size: 26px; line-height: 34px; }
      .faq__subheading { font-size: 22px; line-height: 28px; }
      .faq__question { padding: 14px var(--space-md); }

    }

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       JS — FAQModule
       Enhances native <details> with:
       · Smooth height animation (grid-rows trick)
       · Single-open: closes others on open
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const FAQModule = {
        items: [],

        init() {
          this.items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.faq__item'));
          if (!this.items.length) return;

          const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia(
            '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
          ).matches;

          this.items.forEach(item => {
            const summary = item.querySelector('.faq__question');
            const answer  = item.querySelector('.faq__answer');
            if (!summary || !answer) return;

            summary.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              e.preventDefault();

              if (item.open) {
                // Close: animate then remove [open]
                if (!prefersReduced) {
                  answer.style.gridTemplateRows = '0fr';
                  answer.style.paddingTop    = '0';
                  answer.style.paddingBottom = '0';
                  answer.addEventListener('transitionend', () => {
                    item.open = false;
                  }, { once: true });
                } else {
                  item.open = false;
                }
              } else {
                // Close all others first
                this._closeOthers(item, prefersReduced);
                // Open this one
                item.open = true;
                // Force reflow then animate open
                if (!prefersReduced) {
                  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                      answer.style.gridTemplateRows = '1fr';
                      answer.style.paddingTop    = '20px';
                      answer.style.paddingBottom = '20px';
                    });
                  });
                }
              }
            });
          });
        },

        _closeOthers(current, prefersReduced) {
          this.items.forEach(item => {
            if (item === current || !item.open) return;
            const answer = item.querySelector('.faq__answer');
            if (answer && !prefersReduced) {
              answer.style.gridTemplateRows = '0fr';
              answer.style.paddingTop    = '0';
              answer.style.paddingBottom = '0';
              answer.addEventListener('transitionend', () => {
                item.open = false;
              }, { once: true });
            } else {
              item.open = false;
            }
          });
        },
      };

      document.readyState === 'loading'
        ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => FAQModule.init())
        : FAQModule.init();
    })();
  </script>


  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       JS — TestimonialsModule
       Pure CSS-transform slider. No libraries.
       Calculates card width + gap at runtime
       to handle any responsive breakpoint.
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const TestimonialsModule = {
        track:    null,
        cards:    [],
        btnPrev:  null,
        btnNext:  null,
        current:  0,      // index of leftmost visible card
        visible:  3,      // cards visible at once (recalculated on resize)

        init() {
          this.track   = document.getElementById('testimonials-track');
          this.btnPrev = document.getElementById('btn-prev');
          this.btnNext = document.getElementById('btn-next');
          if (!this.track) return;

          this.cards = Array.from(this.track.querySelectorAll('.testimonials__card'));
          this._calcVisible();
          this._updateNav();

          this.btnPrev.addEventListener('click', () => this._slide(-1));
          this.btnNext.addEventListener('click', () => this._slide(1));

          // Recalculate on resize
          let resizeTimer;
          window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
              this._calcVisible();
              // Clamp current index after resize
              const max = Math.max(0, this.cards.length - this.visible);
              this.current = Math.min(this.current, max);
              this._applyTransform();
              this._updateNav();
            }, 150);
          });

          // Touch/swipe support
          this._bindSwipe();
        },

        _calcVisible() {
          const w = window.innerWidth;
          this.visible = w <= 540 ? 1 : w <= 900 ? 2 : 3;
        },

        _cardWidth() {
          if (!this.cards.length) return 0;
          const card = this.cards[0];
          const gap  = parseInt(getComputedStyle(this.track).gap) || 16;
          return card.getBoundingClientRect().width + gap;
        },

        _slide(dir) {
          const max     = Math.max(0, this.cards.length - this.visible);
          this.current  = Math.min(max, Math.max(0, this.current + dir));
          this._applyTransform();
          this._updateNav();
        },

        _applyTransform() {
          const offset = this.current * this._cardWidth();
          this.track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;
        },

        _updateNav() {
          const max = Math.max(0, this.cards.length - this.visible);
          this.btnPrev.disabled = this.current === 0;
          this.btnNext.disabled = this.current >= max;
        },

        _bindSwipe() {
          let startX = 0;
          const threshold = 50;

          this.track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
            startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
          }, { passive: true });

          this.track.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
            const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
            if (Math.abs(diff) > threshold) {
              this._slide(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
            }
          }, { passive: true });
        },
      };

      document.readyState === 'loading'
        ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => TestimonialsModule.init())
        : TestimonialsModule.init();
    })();
  </script>


  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       JS — HowToModule
       Same IntersectionObserver pattern as WhyModule.
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const HowToModule = {
        init() {
          this._animateCards();
        },

        _animateCards() {
          const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.howto__card');
          if (!cards.length || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
            cards.forEach(c => c.classList.add('is-visible'));
            return;
          }

          const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia(
            '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
          ).matches;

          if (prefersReduced) {
            cards.forEach(c => c.classList.add('is-visible'));
            return;
          }

          const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
                observer.unobserve(entry.target);
              }
            });
          }, { threshold: 0.12 });

          cards.forEach(card => observer.observe(card));
        },
      };

      document.readyState === 'loading'
        ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => HowToModule.init())
        : HowToModule.init();
    })();
  </script>


  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       JS — WhyModule
       IntersectionObserver drives staggered
       card entrance animations on scroll.
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const WhyModule = {
        init() {
          this._animateCards();
        },

        _animateCards() {
          const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.why__card');
          if (!cards.length || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
            cards.forEach(c => c.classList.add('is-visible'));
            return;
          }

          const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia(
            '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
          ).matches;

          if (prefersReduced) {
            cards.forEach(c => c.classList.add('is-visible'));
            return;
          }

          const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
                observer.unobserve(entry.target); // fire once
              }

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       JS — TrustedModule
       Pauses carousel on reduced-motion preference.
       Wires up IntersectionObserver so animation
       only runs when section is in viewport
       (performance: GPU layer only when needed).
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const TrustedModule = {
        init() {
          this._handleReducedMotion();
          this._pauseWhenOffscreen();
        },

        _handleReducedMotion() {
          const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia(
            '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
          ).matches;
          if (!prefersReduced) return;

          const track = document.querySelector('.trusted__track');
          if (track) track.style.animation = 'none';
        },

        _pauseWhenOffscreen() {
          const track = document.querySelector('.trusted__track');
          const carousel = document.querySelector('.trusted__carousel');
          if (!track || !carousel || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

          const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
              track.style.animationPlayState =
                entry.isIntersecting ? 'running' : 'paused';
            });
          }, { threshold: 0 });

          observer.observe(carousel);
        },
      };

      document.readyState === 'loading'
        ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => TrustedModule.init())
        : TrustedModule.init();
    })();
  </script>
  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       JS — HeroModule
       Self-contained IIFE. No dependencies.
       Replays entrance animations via
       IntersectionObserver on section re-entry.
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      const HeroModule = {
        init() {
          this._watchVisibility();
        },

        _watchVisibility() {
          const section = document.querySelector('.hero');
          if (!section || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

          const prefersMotion = !window.matchMedia(
            '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
          ).matches;
          if (!prefersMotion) return;

          const animated = [
            '.hero__heading',
            '.hero__body',
            '.hero__actions',
          ].map(sel => document.querySelector(sel)).filter(Boolean);

          let hasPlayed = false;

          const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
              if (entry.isIntersecting && hasPlayed) {
                animated.forEach(el => {
                  el.style.animation = 'none';
                  void el.offsetWidth; // force reflow
                  el.style.animation = '';
                });
              }
              if (entry.isIntersecting) hasPlayed = true;
            });
          }, { threshold: 0.2 });

          observer.observe(section);
        },
      };

      document.readyState === 'loading'
        ? document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => HeroModule.init())
        : HeroModule.init();
    })();
  </script>
